method: Visual transcription of the English signed order after English OCR located its clauses; OCR text is not treated as a verified transcription.

sunday_clause.meaning: The order states that these heavy-vehicle movement restrictions do not apply on Sundays throughout the day.
sunday_clause.scope_limit: This is not evidence that every independent road restriction or vehicle rule is removed on Sundays.

predecessor.continued_terms: All other terms and conditions of the predecessor remain unchanged and in force.

vehicle_exceptions_status: Cannot infer an empty exception set: the amendment incorporates terms from the unlocated predecessor.
limitations: The predecessor is absent from the acquired notice index under its stated number and date; the index is not proof of complete publication coverage.
The exact heavy-vehicle classification and any inherited passenger-bus or essential-service exceptions require the predecessor.
The notification text must be joined to the correct highway carriageways and checked against later amendments before simulation use.
This transcription does not establish a restriction outside the Bandra-Dahisar corridor or on every road of the metropolitan region.
